cost_margin: per-cell training wall ratio <=1.25 and latent bytes ratio <=1; descriptive shared-host diagnostics only
evidence_scope: visible generated software/learning characterization; no fresh confirmatory reasoning, hardware or quantum advantage claim

four_state.scale: float64 mean(abs(latent))/2; clamp to 1e-8; round float32
four_state.surrogate: unit abs<3 passes gradient; detached scale; boundary/outside zero
four_state.thresholds: abs(unit)>2 chooses magnitude 3; otherwise 1; zero positive; boundary ties toward zero

controls: one-sided deterministic hash-permutation of right trajectory
geometry.positions: all prompt byte positions, exclude BOS and EOS; cumulative causal context
geometry.primary: equal family/task mean of same-item/different-carrier minus same-carrier/different-item; order1 arclength cosine
geometry.selection: training only; first three semantic identities per family/task sorted by identity, both carriers

primary: final-step greedy exact complete answer plus EOS; test macro family mean; all seeds retained
qec_families: physical error support site; both tasks and carriers grouped; hash-rank 3/1/1 sites
quality_margin: quantized minus dense test accuracy >= -0.05; descriptive diagnostic only
selection: final update only; no early stopping, validation selection or test tuning

training.selection: final-step; no early stopping; no test evaluation

uncertainty: mean/min/max across three paired seeds and raw paired differences; descriptive, no significance claim
